description: The 3D mockup of a line's artwork on the product, as an image. An order job is rendered by Printdash's server and cached; if it is still rendering the result says so and you call again in about 20 seconds. A cart or quote line returns the mockup checkout or the quote page stored, or else Printdash's server renders it the same way (rendering, then call again); the flat preview comes back when there is no 3D view to show. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

design.description: Which design (1 to N) on a job with several designs. Omit on a one-design job.

kind.description: cart_line (line_id from get_cart), quote_line (line_id from get_quote) or order_item (item_id from get_order).

side.description: front (default) or back, on a double-sided job.

name: get_mockup
title: Show the 3D mockup
